name: commons-bonus-last
description: ⭐ THE PAIRED CONTROL FOR C2, THE TURN ORDER, AND IT IS A CONTROL FOR A REVERSAL RATHER THAN FOR AN EXPERIMENT. The commons takes the bonus FIRST (rules.turn.bonusTiming 'start', Dean 09/09/2026, whose reason in full is that A TURN VISIBLY ENDS ON THE MAIN ACTION). That REVERSES the ruling of 03/09/2026, which put the bonus last and was itself called a correction rather than an experiment - the engine and both design docs had carried 'start' since 19/08/2026 and were wrong about the game. This arm restores 'end'. It replaces overlays/bonus-first.overlay.json, which pointed the other way, became a no-op on the flip and is retired to overlays/retired/. ⚠️ THE TWO ORDERS ARE NOT ORDERABLE BY POWER, so do not read either as a buff. Under 'start' the bonus can FUEL the action that follows it, and under the commons that fuel line is the biggest any version of this game has had: a bought Harvest of a central pile can put four cards in your barn and the main action that follows can Deliver them. Under 'end' the action can SET THE BOARD UP instead - build a building, then Grow it through the Apiary board; harvest into your barn, then Deliver through the Vegetable one. READ IN THIS ORDER. (1) THE DOOR MIX, which is what moved last time and is the reading this arm exists for: the Wheat and Vegetable boards are the two whose value depends on what the turn has already produced, and they are also the two every version of this game has found underused, so 'end' should help them and 'start' should not. (2) The bonus RATE against Dean's 30-60% band, because a bonus that must be decided before the turn is a harder decision and may simply be taken less often - which would be the band moving for a reason that is not the design's fault. (3) Slot-unspent, which reads the window, but remember its absolute is a rational floor a bot cannot fail and only the delta between the two arms means anything. (4) Actions per turn and game length together. ⭐ WHAT WOULD MAKE THIS ARM WIN, stated in advance so it cannot be rationalised afterwards: 'end' taking a materially more even door mix at the same bonus rate. If it does, the 03/09 correction was right about the game and Dean's 09/09 reversal is buying legibility with balance, which is a trade he is entitled to make but should be told he is making. ⛔ PASSENGERS PINNED 12/09/2026: Dean's plain-action balloon and Village Store ruling moved sixteen shipped leaves at once. This overlay predates that flip and every report taken against it does too, so each of those leaves is pinned here BY NAME at its PRE-FLIP value. Without it an arm read as a delta against a pre-flip base would silently gain a one-card flight, an always-present Aerodrome and a live coin economy. That is the 05/09/2026 passenger lesson: an overlay that should not move with the shipped default has to pin every knob the flip moved.
